notes: It threw undefined is not an object (evaluating 'render(tab, v).catch') on every open. The renderer set its markup and fired its fetch but never returned the promise, and the dispatcher calls render(tab, v).catch(...) to surface failures — so a renderer returning undefined crashes the view instead of showing it. The tab shipped in 3.4.0 and has never once displayed content. Two fixes. The renderer returns its promise, as every other renderer already did.
